en: Theragāthā 2.41 Dukanipāta, Pañcamavagga The Elder’s Verses 2.41 Second Book of Twos, Fifth Chapter: The Chapter on the Five Hundred Elders (Pañcasatā Vagga) I am one who has abandoned all, who has cut off all ties, and who has destroyed all attachments. Having reached the end of the realm of existence, I am now cool and peaceful. I have attained the state of peace; I am free from fear. I have crossed over the flood; I am a sage who has reached the further shore. I have no more birth; I have lived the holy life. What was to be done has been done; there is nothing further to be done.
